newer_changes_search: Previous blocker (old MGNREGA wage rates) fixed: the content now cites Gazette S.O. 3518(E) of 30 Jun 2026 (state-wise wage rates under section 10 from 1 Jul 2026, superseding S.O. 463(E) of 26 Feb 2013); the snapshot text matches. Web search found no later change to the Act's entitlements (125 days, 15-day allotment, unemployment allowance) after the 1 Jul 2026 commencement.

findings.note: Every statement matches a quoted source: 125 days, 15 days or unemployment allowance, weekly / within a fortnight of muster-roll closure via DBT, state-wise rates from 1 Jul 2026 (Gazette), 5 km / 10% extra, peak-season pause. how_to_apply (names, ages, address; e-KYC job cards valid; oral, form 6 or online) matches the FAQ and commencement release. Hindi matches.
findings.suggestion: Optional: add the minimum Rs 300 a day only with a quote from the Schedule.

findings.note: rural (area == rural) and age_min (>= 18) match the FAQ ('Every rural household whose adult members ...', 'Adult members of rural areas may demand employment'). 'guidance' fits a PIB FAQ. Fixtures cover 17/18, urban and missing fields.
findings.suggestion: Optional: cite the Act (Gazette) to raise confidence to 'confirmed'.

findings.note: aadhaar (optional) cites the commencement release, which mentions only 'e-KYC verified job cards'. Loose but acceptable for an optional document.
'can get up to 125 days of work' and 'paid into your bank' are second person; acceptable because the Act creates a legal guarantee, but third person is the house style.
findings.suggestion: Optional: 'The household may get up to 125 days ...', 'paid into the worker's bank ...'.
